description: This file contains the implementation of ArrayStreamBufferWriter, a struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> and writes to a stream using an internal array buffer with resize capabilities.

classes.name: ArrayStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> to write to a stream via an internal buffer, allowing efficient buffer management and writing.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position by a specified count, writing the buffer contents to the stream.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> over the buffer from the current position, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> over the buffer from the current position, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: CheckAndResizeBuffer
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has enough space for the requested size hint, resizing if needed.

methods.name: ThrowNegativeSizeHint
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentException if sizeHint is negative.

methods.name: ThrowNegativeAdvanceCount
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentException if count is negative.

methods.name: ThrowAdvancePastCapacity
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException if an advance is attempted past the current capacity.
